headline: LAA @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAA 4.35 at ARI 4.46, with a projected total of 8.81. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: LAA moved +0.09 runs while ARI moved +0.34, changing the projected margin by -0.26 runs. The projected total climbed +0.46, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Sam Aldegheri has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Jo Adell, Ketel Marte, Zach Neto, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ildemaro Vargas, Jorge Barrosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
